- Downloads: a link of the Stremio server on the phone (http://127.0.0.1:11470/<hash>/<file number>?tr=...) was saved as "64", the number at the end of the link. The real name of the video is now asked from the server; without it the file is named "video-<hash>-<number>". A file whose name has no extension gets one from the content type (video/mp4 -> .mp4, video/x-matroska -> .mkv ...).
- Downloads from a player app ("external player" in Stremio): the start no longer waits for the video's name (it is asked once the stream answers, and the file is named video-<hash>-<number> until then); a torrent stream is fetched on one connection, in order, instead of eight at once (it started slowly); the wait for the first bytes may last up to two and a half minutes instead of thirty seconds.
- Downloads: a link to an HLS playlist (.m3u8) saved the playlist text, not the video. The playlist is now read, the best quality is picked, and its pieces are downloaded in order (four at a time) into one .ts file (.mp4 for fragmented MP4); AES-128 encrypted pieces are decrypted; the percent follows the pieces.
